news.story: Daniels was a beast on both ends of the floor, nudging a rare quadruple-double despite scoring just nine points. Although his offensive output has been somewhat underwhelming, Daniels' contributions across the board have been ultra effective. Look for him to continue racking up the stats when Atlanta hosts the Lakers on Monday.

news.headline: Daniels finished Friday's 139-132 victory over Washington with 13 points (6-9 FG, 0-1 3Pt, 1-1 FT), nine rebounds, 12 assists and two steals across 34 minutes.
news.story: Daniels fell one rebound short of a triple-double, including a season-high 12 assists. While the steals have been relatively consistent, Daniels has been a beast on the glass over the past three games, averaging 11.3 rebounds during that span. He has been a top-50 player thus far this season, averaging 9.9 points, 6.9 rebounds, 5.3 assists and 2.6 steals in 30.1 minutes per game.

news.story: Daniels was a beast on both ends of the floor, nudging a rare quadruple-double despite scoring just nine points. Although his offensive output has been somewhat underwhelming, Daniels' contributions across the board have been ultra effective. Look for him to continue racking up the stats when Atlanta hosts the Lakers on Monday.

news.headline: Daniels finished Friday's 139-132 victory over Washington with 13 points (6-9 FG, 0-1 3Pt, 1-1 FT), nine rebounds, 12 assists and two steals across 34 minutes.
news.story: Daniels fell one rebound short of a triple-double, including a season-high 12 assists. While the steals have been relatively consistent, Daniels has been a beast on the glass over the past three games, averaging 11.3 rebounds during that span. He has been a top-50 player thus far this season, averaging 9.9 points, 6.9 rebounds, 5.3 assists and 2.6 steals in 30.1 minutes per game.

Look for him to continue racking up the stats when Atlanta hosts the Lakers on Monday.

news.headline: Daniels finished Friday's 139-132 victory over Washington with 13 points (6-9 FG, 0-1 3Pt, 1-1 FT), nine rebounds, 12 assists and two steals across 34 minutes.
news.story: Daniels fell one rebound short of a triple-double, including a season-high 12 assists. While the steals have been relatively consistent, Daniels has been a beast on the glass over the past three games, averaging 11.3 rebounds during that span. He has been a top-50 player thus far this season, averaging 9.9 points, 6.9 rebounds, 5.3 assists and 2.6 steals in 30.1 minutes per game.

He has been a top-50 player thus far this season, averaging 9.9 points, 6.9 rebounds, 5.3 assists and 2.6 steals in 30.1 minutes per game.

opp_injuries.name: Chet Holmgren
opp_injuries.note: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

opp_injuries.name: Jalen Williams
opp_injuries.note: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.

news.headline: Sunday's fantasy basketball adds and bets to make in the NBA
Acuff finished Friday's 120-107 loss to the Trail Blazers with 17 points (6-19 FG, 3-10 3Pt, 2-2 FT), four rebounds, six assists and two steals over 35 minutes.
news.story: The rookie had to work for his 17 points Friday, needing 19 shots and going just 3-for-10 from deep, though he matched Zach LaVine for the team lead with six assists. Acuff has been handed a lot of responsibility on a struggling Kings team, and nights like this are part of the learning curve. news.headline: Gilgeous-Alexander finished Friday's 113-112 loss to the Clippers with 40 points (15-26 FG, 2-4 3Pt, 8-11 FT), four rebounds, five assists and one steal in 38 minutes.
news.story: Gilgeous-Alexander did everything he could to carry a shorthanded Oklahoma City team, scoring 40 points and hitting a leaning three that put the Thunder up four with three minutes left. He had a chance to win it at the buzzer, but his 21-foot jumper missed, and the Thunder dropped a season-high third straight game. With Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg) and Cason Wallace (shoulder) all out since late…

news.headline: Oklahoma City Thunder vs. LA Clippers: Game Highlights
Gilgeous-Alexander posted 31 points (9-20 FG, 0-7 3Pt, 13-14 FT), four rebounds, two assists and a steal across 36 minutes in Wednesday's 118-108 loss to the Trail Blazers.
news.story: Gilgeous-Alexander overcame a difficult perimeter shooting performance by getting to the free-throw line consistently, converting 13 of 14 attempts en route to posting a seventh consecutive game with at least 25 points.
